# @warda_protocol/vendor

> 标签: agent-payments, http-402, kaspa, paid-api, vendor, x402

## 简介

Sell an API for Kaspa over HTTP 402. Quotes a price, then verifies the payment is in the UTXO set before serving — it never trusts the payment header.
